# Suyat Dental Clinic

> Suyat Dental Clinic is a dental clinic with two branches, San Nicolas in Pangasinan and Project 6 in Quezon City, Philippines. It offers cleaning and checkups, restorations, braces consultations, teeth whitening and extractions, with after-hours appointments by prior arrangement. Patients book through an online AI receptionist.

Suyat Dental Clinic is for patients in and around San Nicolas, Pangasinan and Project 6, Quezon City. Appointments are confirmed by the clinic team.

## Pages

- [Home](https://suyatdental.com/): the clinic overview, the six service areas, how to book in three steps, branch addresses and opening days and hours, and the AI receptionist for booking.
